visualReview.method: Opened actual final desktop.png, mobile.png, preview.png with the image view tool; also inspected full-page and lab captures.
visualReview.desktop: Clear forest-green orbital hero, yellow primary action, restrained navigation, consistent editorial spacing, aligned three-column lesson grid.
visualReview.mobile: Readable single-column layout and responsive controls. Headline reduced to 39px to avoid an extra line; real solar art is retained below the action.
visualReview.lab: Scrolled mobile laboratory retains sticky close control. Safety, method, controls, observations and challenge remain available without horizontal overflow.
visualReview.limitations: 1200x900 official preview is a first-screen screenshot; full-page captures are supplemental and fixed rails may appear at the restored scroll offset.
